Transaction execution, epoch transitions, genesis setup, fee handling, and bank hash updates.

# Purpose
This file implements the main runtime control flow for block and transaction execution. It connects bank state, account storage, fee handling, sysvar updates, leader schedule generation, epoch transitions, and genesis setup. The code also contains helpers for transaction pre-checks, address lookup table loading, account finalization, and bank hash updates. Many functions mirror Agave runtime behavior so the execution path, fee rules, and error handling match Solana semantics.

The file also manages state changes at block boundaries and epoch boundaries. It updates vote and stake caches, activates features, applies builtin program transitions, distributes rewards, and freezes the bank after execution. In addition, it supports offline replay and genesis initialization by loading genesis accounts, writing builtin program accounts, and preparing the first bank state. Public entry points such as [`fd_runtime_pre_execute_check`](<#fd_runtime_pre_execute_check>), [`fd_runtime_prepare_and_execute_txn`](<#fd_runtime_prepare_and_execute_txn>), [`fd_runtime_read_genesis`](<#fd_runtime_read_genesis>), and [`fd_runtime_block_execute_finalize`](<#fd_runtime_block_execute_finalize>) expose the main runtime operations used by the rest of the system.
